QuestInfo.name: To Ereve
QuestInfo.0: You learned a lot of useful information about Maple World from #b#p9110002##k. You should think about what to do next.
QuestInfo.1: Meet with Empress Cygnus in Ereve. Talk to the Perry the Pelican at Mushroom Shrine to travel to Six Path Crossway. Then take a flight to Ereve from there.
QuestInfo.2: After a long journey, you've arrived in Ereve. On your arrival, you were immediately approached by a man wishing to speak with you.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: #Wbasic# Can proceed to 'Audience with the Empress'

0.0: I should remember these three names: Maple World, Victoria Island, and Ossyria. My immediate destination is Ereve, which is accessible from Six Path Crossway. I can take my time investigating Ossyria and Edelstein afterward.
0.1: Just like Kino Konoko suggested, I should go to Ereve and talk to Empress Cygnus. Warp Helper Perry on the western side of Mushroom Shrine can send me directly to Six Path Crossway. From there, I can take the plane to Ereve.

1.0: Huh? Who are you? You came to see the Empress?
